root_cause.hypothesis: Alarm likely transient/self-resolved or false-positive: at snapshot time service healthy (running=desired=2, no pending, no failed deployments). CPU near-zero (~0.003%) suggests possible idle/traffic-drop or alarm tied to low-CPU threshold rather than crash/failure. One deployment in flight but not failed — could just be routine rolling deploy caught mid-transition. No logs or deploy history provided to confirm root cause.

proposal.expected_effect: No change; service remains healthy. Alarm likely self-resolves once deployment completes or traffic normalizes.
